lesson_title: Lesson 4: STEM Project Reports and Experiments
lesson_description: In this lesson, students will delve into the specific requirements and writing styles for project reports in STEM fields. They will also learn about conducting experiments and performing statistical analysis in their reports, laying a strong foundation for future projects.

subtopics.title: Subtopic 1: Grammar and Vocabulary
subtopics.description: This subtopic covers essential grammar and vocabulary skills for writing project reports. It includes learning about passive voice, reported speech, and concord. Estimated Characters: 250

subtopics.title: Subtopic 2: Signpost Words and Cohesive Devices
subtopics.description: Understanding and using signpost words and cohesive devices to improve paragraph writing in project reports. Estimated Characters: 270

subtopics.title: Subtopic 3: Technical vs. General Writing
subtopics.description: Distinguishing between technical writing in STEM fields and general writing. Estimated Characters: 280

subtopics.title: Subtopic 4: Project Report Definition
subtopics.description: Defining what a project report is and its importance in STEM fields. Estimated Characters: 260

subtopics.title: Subtopic 5: Project Report Structure
subtopics.description: Learning the basic structure of a project report, including introduction, methods, results, and conclusion sections. Estimated Characters: 290

subtopics.title: Subtopic 6: Types of Reports in STEM
subtopics.description: Identifying different types of project reports used in STEM fields, such as research reports and case studies. Estimated Characters: 270

subtopics.title: Subtopic 7: Purpose and Audience of Reports
subtopics.description: Understanding the purpose and intended audience for different types of project reports. Estimated Characters: 280

subtopics.title: Subtopic 8: Plagiarism and Proper Citations
subtopics.description: Recognizing and avoiding plagiarism in project reports, including proper citation methods. Estimated Characters: 270

subtopics.title: Subtopic 9: Conducting Experiments
subtopics.description: Learning how to design and conduct experiments as part of a project report. Estimated Characters: 280

subtopics.title: Subtopic 10: Statistical Analysis in Reports
subtopics.description: Understanding and applying statistical analysis techniques in project reports. Estimated Characters: 260
